description: Variant matrix for A/B testing. Each key defines an axis of variation. The build_variants.py script generates the Cartesian product of all values.

plinth_colour.description: Plinth bottom colour (material name from model)

hole_mode.description: Pin hole type: through, blind, or auto

plinth_outset.description: Plinth footprint outset in mm (avoids zero-width edges)

decimate_target_tris.description: Target triangle count for low-poly preview

filters.description: Optional filters to exclude invalid combinations
